verdict.rationale: HubSpot's first-party docs describe a dedicated custom objects API that lets organizations represent data based on unique business requirements, then create, update and batch-retrieve custom object records. Custom objects are treated as first-class records elsewhere too, for example in deduplication. Associations between objects appear in the import docs, but only for standard objects. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of defining custom object schemas and properties (fields), evidence of associations involving custom objects specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
